The candidates all supported bringing street vendors back, but moderator Maria Antonieta Mejía pressed them to explain how they would protect vendors. Their proposals included a committee or commission with vendors, a broader community-and-city planning process, and designated vending spaces. Jackie Fielder also called for vendors’ voices and protection from criminalization.
